description: Scrape restaurant listings from Glovo by city, or search by keyword within a city. Results can be expanded beyond the first page by scanning Glovo's cuisine-filtered listing pages.

city.description: City to scrape Glovo restaurants for.
city.title: City

cuisine.description: Optional. Matched case-insensitively against Glovo's cuisine tags, e.g. `Pizza`, `Sushi`, `Italiana`, `Burgers`. Tags are shown in the local language of the selected city; `pizza` and `burgers` work in every market.
cuisine.title: Cuisine filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Glovo embeds 50 restaurants per category page; larger values scan additional cuisine-filtered pages until the cap or maxPages is reached.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum number of Glovo listing pages to request (the first page plus cuisine-filtered pages). Each page carries up to 50 restaurants and requests are deduplicated.
maxPages.title: Max listing pages

minRating.description: Drop restaurants with a customer satisfaction score (0-100) below this value.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: `Browse restaurants` lists every restaurant Glovo shows for the selected city (optionally filtered by cuisine). `Search` additionally filters restaurants by a keyword matched against the restaurant name and cuisine tag.
mode.title: Mode

onlyOpen.description: Only return restaurants that are currently open for delivery.
onlyOpen.title: Only currently open

onlyTopRated.description: Only return restaurants Glovo has flagged as top-rated.
onlyTopRated.title: Only top-rated

onlyWithPromotions.description: Only return restaurants that currently have at least one active discount/deal (e.g. percentage off, 2x1).
onlyWithPromotions.title: Only with active promotions

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Glovo does not require a proxy from most locations, but you can enable Apify's free datacenter proxy (AUTO group) for extra reliability.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

query.description: Required when mode=search. Matched (case-insensitive) against restaurant name and cuisine tag, e.g. `pizza`, `sushi`, `mcdonald`.
query.title: Search keyword

sortBy.description: Order in which Glovo lists the restaurants: its own recommendation order, customer rating, delivery fee, or distance from the city centre.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Glovo Restaurant Scraper Input
